purpose: Define `#SHOP` as the reserved root for shopping/list-style everyday semantics exposed through canonical data and operations, while presentation under Studio/Everyday remains a projection.

value.owner_rule: #SHOP resolves to explicit shopping/list domain semantics and operations.
value.data_rule: Shopping entries/items are explicit canonical data with stable identity where machine-significant.
value.operation_rule: Add/edit/remove/check/clear or similar mutations require explicit canonical operations.
value.studio_rule: Shopping UI may live under Studio/Everyday but Studio does not become the semantic owner.
value.ordering_rule: List presentation order is non-semantic unless an owning field explicitly defines order/priority.
value.authority_rule: Visibility or possession of a shopping list does not grant unrelated runtime authority.
value.projection_rule: Web/mobile/CLI list views are projections of the same #SHOP semantics.
